The richest signal for "is this server healthy, and why not."", "parameters": [{"$ref": "#/components/parameters/projectId"}, {"$ref": "#/components/parameters/serverId"}], "requestBody": {"$ref": "#/components/requestBodies/emptyBody"}, "responses": {"200": {"description": "Doctor report. `status` summarizes the outcome; per-step detail is in `checks`.", "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/DoctorReport"}}}}, "400": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/ValidationError"}, "401": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"}, "403": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Forbidden"}, "404": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/NotFound"}, "429": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/RateLimited"}, "500": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/InternalError"}, "502": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/ServerUnreachable"}, "504": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Timeout"}}}}
/projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/accounts/{account} {"parameters": [{"$ref": "#/components/parameters/projectId"}, {"$ref": "#/components/parameters/serverId"}, {"$ref": "#/components/parameters/account"}], "get": {"operationId": "getServerAccount", "tags": ["Server accounts"], "summary": "Get a server account", "description": "One account, by id or name. Another member's personal account answers `404`, the same as a missing one. A name two accounts share answers `409` with `details.code: "account_name_ambiguous"` and both ids in `details.accountIds`.", "responses": {"200": {"description": "The account.", "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/ServerAccount"}, "example": {"id": "acct_7f3a9c", "name": "test-automation-1", "kind": "personal", "isDefault": false, "needsReconnect": false, "hostedOnly": true, "expiresAt": 1781142000000, "createdAt": 1781138400000, "updatedAt": 1781138400000}}}}, "401": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"}, "403": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Forbidden"}, "404": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/NotFound"}, "409": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Conflict"}, "429": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/RateLimited"}, "500": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/InternalError"}}}, "put": {"operationId": "uploadServerAccountTokens", "tags": ["Server accounts"], "summary": "Upload tokens to a server account", "description": "Creates the account (`201`) or replaces its token in place (`200`, same id). A well-formed account id never creates one: an unknown id is `404`. Any other reference is a name, and a name no account has creates the account.

Nothing checks who a token belongs to. The name is your own label, and replacing a token replaces it whoever it belongs to.

The account becomes **hosted-only**: hosted runs use it, and no local app, browser or sandbox ever receives its token. Tokens are used with the server URL saved in the project, so the body takes no URL. ID tokens are refused. Each token field is at most 16 KB.

Uploads to one server are budgeted per person: 60, refilling at 120 an hour. Past it the answer is `429` with `Retry-After` and `details.retryAfterMs`. On a server shared with the project, only project admins upload, and a member gets `403`.

The answer is the account, never a token.", "requestBody": {"required": true, "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/ServerAccountTokensRequest"}, "example": {"tokens": {"sensitive_value": "[REDACTED]", "expires_in": 3600}, "clientInformation": {"clientId": "client_123"}}}}}, "responses": {"200": {"description": "The token was replaced; the account keeps its id.", "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/ServerAccount"}, "example": {"id": "acct_7f3a9c", "name": "test-automation-1", "kind": "personal", "isDefault": false, "needsReconnect": false, "hostedOnly": true, "expiresAt": 1781142000000, "createdAt": 1781138400000, "updatedAt": 1781138400000}}}}, "201": {"description": "The account was created.", "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/ServerAccount"}, "example": {"id": "acct_7f3a9c", "name": "test-automation-1", "kind": "personal", "isDefault": false, "needsReconnect": false, "hostedOnly": true, "expiresAt": 1781142000000, "createdAt": 1781138400000, "updatedAt": 1781138400000}}}}, "400": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/ValidationError"}, "401": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"}, "403": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Forbidden"}, "404": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/NotFound"}, "409": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Conflict"}, "429": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/RateLimited"}, "500": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/InternalError"}}}, "patch": {"operationId": "updateServerAccount", "tags": ["Server accounts"], "summary": "Rename a server account or make it the default", "description": "Rename the account, make it the default, or both; a rename applies first. A name another account on the server uses answers `409` with `details.code: "account_name_taken"`.

Runs with no saved account choice act as the default. To run evals from CI as one account, make it the default before you start the run, and don't run the same key's runs at the same time with different defaults.", "requestBody": {"required": true, "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/ServerAccountUpdateRequest"}, "example": {"isDefault": true}}}}, "responses": {"200": {"description": "The account.", "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/ServerAccount"}, "example": {"id": "acct_7f3a9c", "name": "test-automation-1", "kind": "personal", "isDefault": false, "needsReconnect": false, "hostedOnly": true, "expiresAt": 1781142000000, "createdAt": 1781138400000, "updatedAt": 1781138400000}}}}, "400": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/ValidationError"}, "401": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"}, "403": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Forbidden"}, "404": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/NotFound"}, "409": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Conflict"}, "429": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/RateLimited"}, "500": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/InternalError"}}}, "delete": {"operationId": "deleteServerAccount", "tags": ["Server accounts"], "summary": "Delete a server account", "description": "Deletes the account and its stored token. The token's issuer is asked to revoke it where the issuer supports revocation (best effort), which also invalidates any copy of the same token you hold.

The default account is refused with `409` and `details.code: "account_is_default"` while other accounts exist, so a delete never changes which account runs act as. Make another account the default first. Send no body.", "responses": {"200": {"description": "The account was deleted.", "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/ServerAccountDeleted"}, "example": {"account": "test-automation-1", "deleted": true}}}}, "400": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/ValidationError"}, "401": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"}, "403": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Forbidden"}, "404": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/NotFound"}, "409": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Conflict"}, "429": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/RateLimited"}, "500": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/InternalError"}}}}
/projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/conformance-runs

{"post": {"operationId": "startConformanceRun", "tags": ["Conformance runs"], "summary": "Start a persisted conformance run", "description": "Grades the saved server against the protocol, apps, and tasks suites and returns `202` with a run id. The target comes from the saved server the path names: a body cannot supply a URL. OAuth is not startable here. Poll the run detail for the verdict. Status, outcome, and score are three different answers.\n\nBy default the run uses the server's saved conformance settings: the checks they select, their tool inputs and their run time budget. The receipt's `settingsSource` says what applied: `saved`, or `defaults` when the server has nothing saved. `settings: \"none\"` runs every check with no tool inputs. With saved settings, the start first checks which MCP protocol version the server speaks and leaves out any suite with no saved checks for that version, as the app does. A retry with the same idempotency key returns the run that key started, with its original suites and settings. A run still going at its budget ends with its unfinished suites incomplete.\n\nOn hosted MCPJam, a user's starts past 30 in 10 minutes can be refused with `429` and `Retry-After`. A server that is restarting also answers `429` with `Retry-After`, with `details.reason` `SERVER_DRAINING`.", "parameters": [{"$ref": "#/components/parameters/projectId"}, {"$ref": "#/components/parameters/serverId"}, {"$ref": "#/components/parameters/launcherHeader"}, {"name": "Idempotency-Key", "in": "header", "required": false, "description": "The body's `idempotencyKey` sent as a header. It wins over the body field.", "schema": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 256}}], "requestBody": {"required": false, "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"suites": {"type": "array", "minItems": 1, "items": {"type": "string", "enum": ["protocol", "apps", "tasks"]}, "description": "Suites to run. Defaults to protocol, apps, and tasks. OAuth is not available on this surface."}, "idempotencyKey": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 200, "description": "Deduplicates a retried POST for the same saved server. Mapped to a namespaced externalRunId (`api:<projectId>:<serverId>:<key>`); a keyless start always inserts and spends quota."}, "protocolVersion": {"type": "string", "enum": ["2025-03-26", "2025-06-18", "2025-11-25", "2026-07-28"], "description": "Pin one MCP protocol version. Without it the run uses the version the server negotiates."}, "engineVersion": {"type": "string"}, "settings": {"type": "string", "enum": ["saved", "none"], "description": "`saved` (the default) runs the server's saved conformance settings. `none` runs every check with no tool inputs."}}}}}}, "responses": {"202": {"description": "The run was accepted and is executing.", "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"type": "object", "required": ["runId", "projectId", "serverId", "status", "deduped", "requestedSuites"], "properties": {"runId": {"type": "string"}, "projectId": {"type": "string"}, "serverId": {"type": "string"}, "status": {"type": "string"}, "deduped": {"type": "boolean"}, "requestedSuites": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}, "settingsSource": {"type": "string", "enum": ["saved", "defaults", "none"], "description": "The settings the run used. `defaults` means the server has no saved settings, so every check runs."}}}}}}, "400": {"description": "The body carried an unknown key or an unknown `protocolVersion`, named OAuth, asked only for suites the saved settings leave out, or the server uses a transport conformance cannot grade."}, "401": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"}, "403": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Forbidden"}, "404": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/NotFound"}, "409": {"description": "The server's saved tool inputs could not be read. Save them again on the Conformance page, or start with `settings: \"none\"`."}, "429": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/RateLimited"}, "500": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/InternalError"}, "502": {"description": "The saved server's address could not be resolved."}}}}
/projects/{projectId}/eval-runs {"post": {"operationId": "createEvalRun", "tags": ["Eval runs"], "summary": "Create an eval run (async)", "description": "Creates a suite run from an existing `suiteId` (rerun) and/or inline `tests`, then **detaches execution and responds `202` immediately** with the `runId`. Validation and quota errors surface on this request; poll `GET /eval-runs/{runId}` for progress. The run appears live in the hosted UI Runs tab, tagged `source: \"api\"`.\n\nA bare `suiteId` with no inline tests reruns the suite as configured. Per-organization concurrency is capped (default 2 concurrent runs); exceeding it returns `429` with `details.reason: \"CONCURRENT_RUN_LIMIT\"`.\n\nFor a suite with attached project environments, pass `environmentId` to choose which one the run uses; the `202` echoes the resolved `environment` triple, and `GET /eval-runs/{runId}` reports the same triple for the life of the run.\n\nTo make the run readable as something more specific than `API` in the Runs table, send `x-mcpjam-launcher` (and `x-mcpjam-ci` from a CI job). Both are labels: `source` is stamped `api` either way.", "parameters": [{"$ref": "#/components/parameters/evalVocabularyHeader"}, {"$ref": "#/components/parameters/projectId"}, {"$ref": "#/components/parameters/launcherHeader"}, {"$ref": "#/components/parameters/ciHeader"}], "requestBody": {"required": true, "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/EvalRunCreateRequest"}, "example": {"suiteName": "smoke", "serverIds": ["srv_abc123"], "tests": [{"title": "echo works", "runs": 1, "model": "anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5", "provider": "anthropic", "steps": [{"id": "s1", "kind": "prompt", "prompt": "Use the echo tool to say hi"}, {"id": "s2", "kind": "assert", "assertion": {"type": "toolCalledWith", "toolName": "echo", "args": {"args": {"text": "hi"}}}}]}]}}}}, "responses": {"202": {"description": "Run created; execution continues in the background.", "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/EvalRunCreated"}, "example": {"runId": "run_abc123", "suiteId": "suite_def456", "status": "running", "caseUpsert": {"committed": [{"name": "echo works"}], "failed": []}, "environment": null}}}}, "400": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/ValidationError"}, "401": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"}, "403": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Forbidden"}, "404": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/NotFound"}, "429": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/RateLimited"}, "500": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/InternalError"}, "502": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/ServerUnreachable"}, "504": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Timeout"}}}}

Past runs are not deleted.\n\nA CI-owned suite (see `EvalSuiteDetail.managedBy`) can be deleted too. The next suite-file sync or SDK report creates it again.", "parameters": [{"$ref": "#/components/parameters/evalVocabularyHeader"}, {"$ref": "#/components/parameters/projectId"}, {"$ref": "#/components/parameters/suiteId"}, {"$ref": "#/components/parameters/declaredSuiteIdQuery"}], "responses": {"200": {"description": "The suite was deleted.", "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/EvalDeleted"}}}}, "401": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"}, "403": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Forbidden"}, "404": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/NotFound"}, "409": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Conflict"}, "429": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/RateLimited"}, "500": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/InternalError"}, "502": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/ServerUnreachable"}}}}
